title: Target in Your Town: How We’re Showing Up in Communities from Coast to Coast
summary: How Target is showing up for communities across the country through volunteerism, small-business support, hiring and more.
body_markdown:
Since our founding, Target has valued generosity — from our commitment to making style affordable for all, to our quest to create a shopping experience full of delightful discovery. But nothing demonstrates the generosity of Target more than the ways our 400,000-plus team members strengthen the communities we call home through supporting small businesses, serving nonprofits and staffing our stores. Here are their stories.


### [Target team members make waves for cleaner New Jersey shores](https://patch.com/new-jersey/asbury-park/target-volunteers-join-clean-ocean-action-s-beach-sweeps-asbury-park-nodx)


Target team members joined local nonprofit Clean Ocean Action for Beach Sweeps across New Jersey, helping remove litter and debris from local shorelines. Together, their efforts supported cleaner beaches and healthier coastal communities for everyone to enjoy.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://patch.com/new-jersey/asbury-park/target-volunteers-join-clean-ocean-action-s-beach-sweeps-asbury-park-nodx)


### [Atlanta Target team celebrates local educators with a classroom surprise](https://patch.com/georgia/atlanta/atlanta-area-educators-surprised-3-000-appreciation-basket-piedmont-road-target-team-nodx)


In honor of Teacher Appreciation Week, team members from Target’s Piedmont Road store surprised educators at St. Peter Claver Regional Catholic School with $3,000 in classroom essentials and teacher must-haves. Handpicked by the team, the donation celebrated the impact teachers make every day while supporting the classrooms and students.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://patch.com/georgia/atlanta/atlanta-area-educators-surprised-3-000-appreciation-basket-piedmont-road-target-team-nodx)


### [Target and Roy Choi give back to the Los Angeles community](https://lamag.com/food/chef-roy-choi-debuts-a-new-snack-line-at-target/)


Target’s Good & Gather collaboration with chef Roy Choi extended beyond the store through a volunteer event with the Los Angeles Regional Food Bank. Together, Target team members and Choi supported the organization’s work, with Target contributing a $100,000 donation to help further its mission across the Los Angeles community.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://lamag.com/food/chef-roy-choi-debuts-a-new-snack-line-at-target/)


### [Target volunteers build lasting impact in Washington, D.C.](https://patch.com/district-columbia/washingtondc/target-volunteers-lend-hand-thearc-farm-partnership-building-bridges-nodx)


More than 100 Target team members joined Building Bridges Across the River for Bullseye Builds at THEARC Farm in Congress Heights, transforming the urban farm with new murals, garden beds and sensory spaces. Target also provided a $5,000 grant to support the organization’s ongoing work in the D.C. community.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://patch.com/district-columbia/washingtondc/target-volunteers-lend-hand-thearc-farm-partnership-building-bridges-nodx)


### [An elevated in-store event grounded in community and style](https://corporate.target.com/news-features/article/2026/02/kbb-by-kahlana-spring-expansion)


Atlanta’s most exclusive shopping event landed in February 2026 with the debut of KBB by Kahlana’s latest collection. The experience honored Atlanta-area Target guests with live music, local flavors and a first look at the apparel.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://corporate.target.com/news-features/article/2026/02/kbb-by-kahlana-spring-expansion)


### Dallas visit sparks team connections in Target


Building a strong team starts with forging relationships at every level of leadership. That’s why new Target CEO Michael Fiddelke kicked off his first week on Feb. 2, 2026, by visiting team members at a local Dallas store — engaging with the team that powers Target every day.


### [Mom-founded supplement brand hits major Target milestone](https://tgt.biz/4338b6)


Seattle-based small business Oat Mama is a heartfelt success story from Target’s Accelerator program. The brand creates nourishing products that support moms through every stage of pregnancy and postpartum, and is now available on Target shelves and online.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/4338b6)


### [Boosting small businesses in Boise](https://boisedev.com/news/2026/01/02/idaho-based-baby-carrier-company-lands-on-target-com/)


Mabē, an Idaho-based brand, brought its baby carriers to our guests through Target — making practical, stylish options accessible to families nationwide.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://boisedev.com/news/2026/01/02/idaho-based-baby-carrier-company-lands-on-target-com/)


### [Target Annapolis hosts annual holiday giving event](https://tgt.biz/611a13)


As part of the 2025 Great Giftogether, our Annapolis, Maryland, team partnered with Walk the Walk Foundation to purchase, wrap and prepare thoughtful gifts for children — continuing our long-standing tradition of community connection and holiday cheer.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/611a13)


### [Connecting kids with community heroes in Indianapolis](https://www.wrtv.com/news/local-news/hamilton-county/shop-for-kids-hamilton-county-officers-help-55-children-ring-in-the-holidays-with-300-shopping-spree)


Resident police officers helped over 50 families in need at Target’s 2025 Heroes & Helpers event in Indianapolis, shopping with kids and spreading holiday magic.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://www.wrtv.com/news/local-news/hamilton-county/shop-for-kids-hamilton-county-officers-help-55-children-ring-in-the-holidays-with-300-shopping-spree)


### [Supporting local youth in Sacramento](https://www.carmichaeltimes.com/2025/12/05/556896/target-to-host-heroes-helpers-event-with-sacramento-police-department-spo-to-support-local-youth)


In December, community public safety partners teamed up with Target to create joyful holiday experiences for kids in Sacramento, California. Since 2009, our Heroes & Helpers programs have helped 100,000-plus children shop with support from local heroes.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://www.carmichaeltimes.com/2025/12/05/556896/target-to-host-heroes-helpers-event-with-sacramento-police-department-spo-to-support-local-youth)


### [A holly-jolly day in Raleigh](https://www.cbs17.com/video/raleigh-police-host-shop-with-a-cop-at-target/11327030/)


Our team in Raleigh, North Carolina, hosted 55 kids and the Cary Police Department for an unforgettable day at Target picking out holiday gifts as part of our Heroes & Helpers program.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://www.cbs17.com/video/raleigh-police-host-shop-with-a-cop-at-target/11327030/)


### [Making holiday memories](https://hoodline.com/2025/12/kenner-police-swap-patrol-for-shopping-carts-to-delight-local-kids-in-helpers-heroes-holiday-event/)


We brought our 2025 Heroes & Helpers program to New Orleans, giving kids a one-of-a-kind holiday shopping experience with local law enforcement and building community connections to last a lifetime.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://hoodline.com/2025/12/kenner-police-swap-patrol-for-shopping-carts-to-delight-local-kids-in-helpers-heroes-holiday-event/)


### [Hands-on heroes behind every package](https://tgt.biz/867db8)


This Houston hub moves 5,000 packages daily, and it’s the trusted staff who make next-day delivery possible, showing that dedication and teamwork bring guaranteed joy.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/867db8)


### [Helping Hands in Silver Spring](https://tgt.biz/c39cdf)


Target volunteers joined forces in Silver Spring, Maryland, to support families new to the community who could use a hand. Together, they built enough furniture to fully furnish 10 apartments.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/c39cdf)


### Highlighting local talent in Las Vegas


Las Vegas-born entrepreneur Whitney Bansin continued her brand’s success as the founder of Wild Collective by launching an exclusive NBA and WNBA line with Target, showcasing heart, style and hometown pride.


[Learn more](https://tgt.biz/01b572)


### [A seat for everyone at Huntsville’s table](https://tgt.biz/f9c9fc)


Target sponsored the 7th annual Village of Promise One Table event in Huntsville, Alabama, serving Thanksgiving dinner to 1,500 people. Open to anyone in the community, the event is a welcoming space to connect with others and feel truly part of the community.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/f9c9fc)


### [Sustainable style starts here](https://tgt.biz/88177c)


Target’s Clothing Take Back Program makes it simple to recycle old apparel, with donation bins at seven San Diego County stores as of November 2025, helping reduce waste responsibly.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/88177c)


### [Target brings holiday help to Huntington](https://tgt.biz/2ba25e)


Ahead of the 2025 Holidays, Target aided West Virginia families — 1 in 6 of whom rely on SNAP — by donating $25,000 to Facing Hunger Food Bank, providing meals to nearly 900 households.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/2ba25e)

### NYC Target volunteers lifted spirits high at the YMCA


On Nov. 11, 2025, 100 Target team members joined NYC’s Bullseye Build day of service, completing hands-on renovations at Greenpoint YMCA and supporting its transitional housing program for families in need.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/12421e)

### [Caring for Maryland communities, one volunteer at a time](https://tgt.biz/f35ad5)


A remarkable 75 Target team members joined the nonprofit A Wider Circle at the Fall 2025 Bullseye Build Day of Service, helping build custom beds, couches, tables, chairs and dressers for families in need across Montgomery County.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/f35ad5)


### Rebuilding joy together at Chicago’s Irving Park YMCA


Target’s property management team volunteered to design and refresh the YMCA’s children’s play hub


—


adding new floors, fresh paint, and a cozy space for families to connect and play.


### [Supporting sustainable brands](https://tgt.biz/b9691d)


Family-owned North Dakota brand Three Farm Daughters, known for pasta made with just two ingredients, joined Target’s 2025 Takeoff program and launched in 116 California stores. It’s now available nationwide online.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/b9691d)


### [Showcasing young talent in Atlanta](https://tgt.biz/9d73a0)


Target celebrated the 2025 winners of its annual HBCU mural competition, including Clark Atlanta University student Temitope Adeyemo, whose piece offered a unique tribute to Atlanta’s musical history in stores across the city.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/9d73a0)


### [Elevating Atlanta community centers](https://tgt.biz/59bcbb)


In October 2025, Target volunteers came together to revitalize the classrooms, pantries and shared spaces at one of Atlanta’s Salvation Army centers — building a safer, more welcoming environment for kids to learn and connect.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/59bcbb)


### A new space for Southern Dallas


In partnership with the Child Poverty Action Lab, Target teams brought the Prosperity Park Project to life in Southern Dallas, turning a vacant lot into a playground where kids and families can gather and play.


> Through the Target Circle community giving program and the dedication of its local team members, Target has helped Green Our Planet expand its mission in tangible ways. The company’s generosity will support curriculum development for more subjects, finance hydroponics programs, and help kids across the Las Vegas Valley experience the magic of growing and eating food they planted themselves.

### [Supporting those who serve in San Diego](https://tgt.biz/5f9284)


During San Diego’s 2025 Blue Star Welcome Week, Target team members assisted military families through events like “Restock Your Pantry,” providing kitchen essentials to ease the relocation process for families new to the area.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/5f9284)


### [Building homes in Colorado](https://tgt.biz/bb75f7)


Target volunteers joined Pikes Peak Habitat for Humanity in Colorado to build affordable homes for local families. With 90% of Pikes Peak Habitat homes built by volunteers, Target team members joined in to help families in Colorado Springs achieve safe, affordable housing.


[Learn more (opens in a new window)](https://tgt.biz/bb75f7)


### Prepping students for school in Brooklyn


Target partnered with the Make a Smile Foundation to provide local students with school essentials and encouragement for a bright year ahead with school supplies and other resources needed for the classroom.


### Flooding support in Texas


In the wake of historic flooding in Texas in summer 2025, Target team members provided critical support, personally delivering supplies and supporting families affected. Target donated $250,000 to efforts and team members mobilized to deliver meals and support to affected families.
